description: Interviews, village walkthroughs, and contest spotlights produced by the DEF CON Video Team at DEF CON 33.

talks.title: HackerPager Engineering and Teardown
talks.teaser: Silk interviews the engineering team behind the HackerPager hardware project, exploring paging protocols and custom firmware design.

talks.title: Hacker Hangout with The Dark Tangent
talks.teaser: An extended conversation with conference founder The Dark Tangent, reflecting on the evolution of DEF CON, hacker ethos, and the wider security community.

talks.title: TipsyBadge: Wobble Mode and Visual Distortions
talks.teaser: A showcase of the TipsyBadge electronic badge, exploring optical manipulation, custom sensors, and interactive firmware effects.

talks.title: ICS Village CTF Overview with Winter
talks.teaser: Winter breaks down the Industrial Control Systems Village CTF challenges, featuring simulated plant automation and PLC exploitation.

talks.title: VetCon Community Showcase with Jim
talks.teaser: Jim shares the mission and background behind the VetCon community, supporting military veterans transitioning into cybersecurity careers.

talks.title: Meshtastic and Mesh Networks at Ham Radio Village
talks.teaser: Lucas and Dan from Ham Radio Village discuss off-grid communications, LoRa packet meshes, and Meshtastic deployments across DEF CON 33.

talks.title: Scam Village: Countering Fraud and Social Engineering
talks.teaser: An introduction to Scam Village, demonstrating safe scam-baiting techniques, telecommunication fraud analysis, and consumer defense.

talks.title: Crypto and Privacy Village Overview with Steven
talks.teaser: Steven outlines hands-on workshops, privacy tool demos, and cryptographic challenges hosted at the Crypto & Privacy Village.

talks.title: IoT Village Spotlight: Connected Device Security
talks.teaser: A fast-paced look at the IoT Village at DEF CON 33, highlighting router hacking challenges, zero-day labs, and device auditing.

talks.title: Physical Security Village Walkthrough
talks.teaser: A walkthrough of the Physical Security Village, featuring lockpicking stations, safe manipulation, and physical access control evaluations.

talks.title: DARPA AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC) Finals Overview
talks.teaser: Andrew Carney from DARPA details the finals of the AI Cyber Challenge, where autonomous AI agents detect and repair software vulnerabilities.

talks.title: QueerCon Community Interview with Kyle
talks.teaser: Kyle discusses the history, community initiatives, and networking spaces organized by QueerCon during DEF CON 33.

talks.title: AIxCC Debrief: Team 42 Beyond Bugs
talks.teaser: Silk interviews the 42 Beyond Bugs team about developing autonomous vulnerability finding and patching agents for DARPA's AIxCC.

talks.title: AIxCC Behind the Scenes: Team Lacrosse
talks.teaser: Silk sits down with Team Lacrosse to explore their autonomous software analysis architecture and strategies during the AIxCC competition.

talks.title: Behind the Scenes with Arts Goon Ch0wn35
talks.teaser: d3dbot interviews Arts & Entertainment Goon Ch0wn35 about event logistics, stage productions, and running DEF CON 33 operations.

talks.title: DDoS Community Interview with d3dbot
talks.teaser: The DDoS Community shares insights with d3dbot regarding distributed denial of service trends, mitigation strategies, and defensive tooling.

talks.title: Introducing Illumicon: Interactive Art and Hacking
talks.teaser: d3dbot interviews the creators of Illumicon, showcasing interactive lighting installations, wearable art, and creative hardware hacking.

talks.title: Speaking at DEF CON: Interview with Andra Lezza
talks.teaser: Helvetigoth interviews first-time speaker Andra Lezza on CFP preparation, stage delivery, and presenting technical research at DEF CON.

talks.title: Open Source in Government: Interview with Jordan Kasper
talks.teaser: Jordan Kasper analyzes the adoption of open-source software in government agencies and public-sector obligations to upstream maintainers.

talks.title: Long-Form Interview: Torvik from Tulip Tree Tech
talks.teaser: Silk conducts a long-form interview with Torvik of Tulip Tree Tech, discussing custom silicon, PCB manufacturing, and indie hardware projects.

talks.title: DARPA AIxCC with Shellphish
talks.teaser: Silk interviews members of legendary hacking group Shellphish on competing in DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge and automated vulnerability reasoning.

talks.title: The DEF CON Run Tradition with Shepard and Panda
talks.teaser: Shepard and Panda join Silk to share the origins, history, and community camaraderie behind the unofficial DEF CON morning run.

talks.title: NextGen Hacking: Youth Education and Mentorship
talks.teaser: Silk explores DEF CON NextGen, a community initiative providing cybersecurity education, hardware soldering, and safe hacking spaces for youth.

talks.title: Hak5 Pager: Paging and Wi-Fi Pineapple Features
talks.teaser: Darren Kitchen presents the Hak5 Pager, exploring retro form factors embedded with modern wireless penetration-testing capabilities.

talks.title: KevOps Sahara Pool Party and Community Gathering
talks.teaser: A look at the KevOps community pool party at the Sahara, celebrating hacker camaraderie, music, and after-hours social traditions.

talks.title: Creating the Electronic Badge: Interview with Mar Williams
talks.teaser: Artist and hardware designer Mar Williams discusses creating the official DEF CON 33 electronic badge and convention visual artwork.

talks.title: Retro Tech Community and Badgelife Live Showcase
talks.teaser: A live panel with d3dbot, psyop, and grrrizzzz exploring the intersection of retro hardware preservation, custom silicon, and badge culture.

talks.title: ICS Village Water Treatment Plant Simulation
talks.teaser: ICS Village engineers explain their fully operational miniature water treatment plant display and process-level exploitation vectors.

talks.title: Ten Years of the IoT Village: Anniversary Preview
talks.teaser: A celebration of ten years of the Internet of Things Village, reviewing a decade of embedded router research, zero-days, and bug bounties.

talks.title: RedAlert ICS CTF Walkthrough
talks.teaser: An introduction to the RedAlert ICS CTF, pitting competitors against simulated critical infrastructure networks and industrial controllers.

talks.title: Bug Bounty Village Remote and In-Person Challenges
talks.teaser: Organizers highlight remote and in-person participation options, live target scopes, and bounty opportunities at Bug Bounty Village.

talks.title: GenSec CTF at DEF CON 33
talks.teaser: A quick look at the GenSec CTF competition at DEF CON 33, challenging participants across diverse cybersecurity skill sets.

talks.title: Red Team Village at DEF CON 33 Spotlight
talks.teaser: An update on attack workshops, offensive tool releases, and adversary emulation labs happening in the Red Team Village at DEF CON 33.

talks.title: Contest Operations Update with Tiberius
talks.teaser: Contest runner Tiberius provides an operational update on official DEF CON 33 contests, scoring protocols, and participant challenges.

talks.title: Mobile Hacking Community Spotlight
talks.teaser: d3dbot catches up with the Mobile Hacking Community at DEF CON 33, exploring baseband analysis, Android internals, and iOS jailbreaking research.
